opportunities.name: Melee-Q crit boundary
opportunities.objective: Test the specifically crit-labelled melee Q using one crit-damage item.
opportunities.mechanic: Q changes from leap damage to a critical hit in melee range, with CriticalDamage retaining Stat(9)[statFormula=2]. Infinity Edge supplies crit damage for a controlled test; AD/lethality and Serylda support the physical sequence. R can bring blades back to an attack/Q target and the final actual attack can trigger three-stack bleed.
opportunities.requiredState: Q cast from measured melee range; initial wounds and incoming shields are fixed.
opportunities.failure: Reaching melee costs health and the crit investment may not affect Q as expected.
opportunities.test: Compare leap versus melee Q with/without Infinity Edge at equal observed AD and armor.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The special Q critical formula does not prove crit chance makes ranged Q or bleed crit.

opportunities.name: Bleed ramp survivor
opportunities.objective: Use the finite bleed window to test physical shred while preserving a second spell cycle.
opportunities.mechanic: W outbound and return apply physical ability damage and wounds; a real attack at three wounds starts two seconds of 2.1 AD[statFormula=2] bleed. Cleaver can ramp on eligible physical packets; Shojin supports basic spells and Deaths Dance buys a bounded recovery chance if a damaged target dies. E terrain cooldown still limits the exit.
opportunities.requiredState: Both W passes and a three-wound attack connect; terrain for E escape is unused.
opportunities.failure: Target escapes before the attack or the bleed kill occurs after Talon dies.
opportunities.test: Record wound application, bleed ticks, Cleaver stacks and time to a second W/Q.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Bleed ticks are not guaranteed separate wound stacks or independently stacking every item effect.

ruledOut.idea: Armor penetration increases every damage type
ruledOut.reason: Talon kit packets shown are physical; penetration supports them but has no universal damage amplification premise.

unknowns: Q crit Stat(9) flag and AD statFormula=2 require numeric resolution. Cleaver/Shojin stacking per bleed packet needs observed logs.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Reaching melee costs health and the crit investment may not affect Q as expected.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The special Q critical formula does not prove crit chance makes ranged Q or bleed crit.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Infinity Edge, Eclipse, Serylda's Grudge, Edge of Night, Youmuu's Ghostblade, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Talon disperses a ring of blades that deal [90 / 135 / 180 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage, gains [(0.4 / 0.55 / 0.7) × 100]% Move Speed, and becomes Invisible for [2.5] seconds. When the Invisibility ends, the blades return to Talon, dealing [90 / 135 / 180 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage again.

If Talon cancels the Invisibility with an Attack or with {{Spell_TalonQ_Name}}, the blades return to the target instead.

Talon's Abilities apply a stack to champions and large jungle monsters they damage for [6] seconds (max 3 stacks).

When Talon Attacks a target with 3 stacks, he deals an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(80 → 280; raw flags preserved) + (2.1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage over [2] seconds.

Talon leaps to a target and deals [65 / 85 / 105 / 125 / 145 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage. If used in melee range, this Ability instead critically strikes for [(65 / 85 / 105 / 125 / 145 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × ((1.5 + (1) × Stat(9)[statFormula=2]))] physical damage.

If this Ability kills the target, Talon restores [characterLevelInterpolation(9 → 55; raw flags preserved)] Health and refunds [50]% of its Cooldown.
